translation_aware.method: joint attitude/body-acceleration law; gyro+acceleration recurrence, output-only magnetic factor
translation_aware.initial_A_source: exact copy of historical gravity-only branch initial A
translation_aware.magnetic_observation_policy: actual-new-observation mask only; independent output law; no law/m/F/S/moments/reference/proposal feedback
translation_aware.magnetic_noise: 2*trace(S_static)/3 I, current and initial-reference individual-reading noise
translation_aware.attitude_prediction: shared independent Bingham gyro increment; joint required moments; finite 19-coefficient forward-KL projection
translation_aware.gyro_prediction_source: body model plus applied residual wrench; right increments of free angular carrier, with aligned full source-factor differences
translation_aware.prediction_action: right model increment acts on the current gyro+acceleration posterior; no reset to the absolute free-model quaternion
translation_aware.prediction_cross_time_dependence: aligned full source factor retained when supplied; conversion of each marginal increment covariance to an independent Bingham transition is an explicit filter approximation, not an exact shared-parameter trajectory posterior
translation_aware.acceleration_prior: declared AR(1) body-frame motion prior; not model-wrench acceleration feedback
translation_aware.integration: deterministic spatial-multimode GH plus Haar MIS; no Monte Carlo
translation_aware.rotation_covariance: 4*E(q_ref).T*Mqq*E(q_ref), right-body quaternion half-angle high-concentration second-moment proxy from full law; not modal-curvature covariance
translation_aware.selected_quaternion: principal axis of full Mqq with continuous hemisphere
translation_aware.full_rotation_moments: E[R] and E[vec_F(R)vec_F(R).T] queried from identical full law once and cached
translation_aware.static_sensor_noise: trace(S)/3 I, same declared real-data calibration as historical branch
translation_aware.corrected_noise: existing lag inversion, full physical tau covariance, smooth/derivative covariance and sparse overlap operators retained
translation_aware.corrected_noise_dependence: per-row gyro/accel laws used in recursion; shared fitted-tau and overlapping-window dependence remains an explicit approximation; cross and full operators retained for external conservative uncertainty propagation

gravity_only.method: native ProbTF Bingham gyro+acceleration recurrence; magnetic fusion only in output
gravity_only.magnetic_observation_policy: new-observation mask only; output factors never carried forward
gravity_only.magnetic_noise: current individual-reading sensor variance plus initial-reference individual-reading variance
gravity_only.gyro_prediction_convention: body-frame right increment, right-end native angular velocity
gravity_only.gyro_prediction_source: body model plus applied residual wrench; right increments of free angular carrier, with aligned full source-factor differences
gravity_only.prediction_cross_time_dependence: source factors retained when supplied; per-step attitude transition independence is an explicit filter approximation
gravity_only.acceleration_covariance_isotropization: lambda_max(C_eff)*I Loewner upper envelope; static sensor noise remains trace(S)/3*I
gravity_only.shared_acceleration_attitude_information: conservative data-dependent envelope; not exact Bayes with shared observations
gravity_only.orientation_covariance: native Bingham-derived high-concentration right rotation coordinates, same A law
gravity_only.propagation: existing deterministic cubature and native quaternion-product moments; no Monte Carlo
gravity_only.estimated_sensor_lag_covariance_units: physical tau seconds squared, order gyro/acceleration
gravity_only.comparison_role: historical gravity-only acceleration evidence; implementation unchanged
gravity_only.full_rotation_moments: same native A law; E[R] and E[vec_F(R) vec_F(R).T]
